r3_constant_section.crown_flat_clip_note: R3 crown and belly rings are exactly flat clips (C15 records) at the constant z

symmetry.definition: half-width above the page centre line minus half-width below it; per-edge error = |d|/2

line_uncertainty_m.conclusion: dimension arrows end on the stroke centre lines within the measured offset; the stroke width does not shift the printed dimension

length_agreement.note: per-view normalisation makes both lengths 44.51 m; the number above is the shift removed by it

outline_bands.rule: band = root-sum-square of the measured drawing-consistency components (linear sum given as the conservative alternative); fit residual and tessellation deviation are separate gates

vs_r3.definition: normalised traced outline minus R3 ledger ring extent at the R3 stations (x < 0.2 and the closure station at x = 44.51 excluded)

fits.rule: interior knots = feature knots (ends of straight stretches >= 1 m) + equidistribution of (|y''|+2e-3)^(2/5)

spacing.dx_growth_note: dx ratio is larger than the meridian ratio at the nose because the radius grows like sqrt(x); the 1.25 limit is applied to the meridian edge length

paper_check.note: per-quad estimate from ring point coordinates; leaning strips and axis-parallel flips are phase B and are not applied; valence of a regular quad-split interior vertex is 6 (flips raise one end by 1)

r3_frame.basis: 98 R3 stations with crown, belly within 1 mm and width within 2 mm; z_w by a parabola fit to the side points of each ring

side_profile_z_offset_m.basis: z = (y_ref - y_pt)/sz + offset, y_ref = mid of the drawn constant crown/belly lines; offset = R3 mid-height 4.02

knot_rule.rule: interior knots = feature knots (ends of straight stretches >= 1 m) + equidistribution of (|y''|+2e-3)^(2/5)
knot_rule.crown_extra: triple (C0) knot at the windshield corner x = 1.395 m reduces the crown maximum residual from 9.64 mm to 4.23 mm

ring_rule.rule: meridian edge length h(x) = min(sqrt(8 delta/kappa), shape_factor x P/N, d_max), gradient-limited |dh/dx| <= growth_gradient; march from both ends, equal steps on the plateau 12-28 m; vertices at crown, both max-width points, belly; equal arc length per quadrant

own_curve_deviation_limit_m.basis: 1.4 x the estimated maximum point distance of triangle centroids, diagonal and edge midpoints from the analytic surface, rounded up to 0.5 mm; the estimate samples points, not every point of every triangle
